name: Nabekane Mikado
source: The protagonist, [url=/c22133]Tsubasa's[/url] older brother and the sisters [url=/c22136]Neneko[/url] and [url=/c22134]Arisu's[/url] childhood friend. Works as a part time traffic safety worker to support himself and his sister since their parents died. He meets [url=/c22135]Carrot[/url] while working and learns of her homeless status. Ever since he was a child he wanted to create a [url=/v5932]Mecha-con[/url] and to marry many girls and make them happy. However because they're poor his sister Tsubasa invents a device called 'Pandora' that downloads information from the internet directly to his brain to help him achieve his goal.
